segments.text: 14 When the kyng heard theſe wordes, he was ſore diſpleaſed wyth hymſelfe, and ſet hys hart on Daniel to deliuer hym, and he laboured til the ſunne went downe to deliuer him.
15 Then theſe men aſſembled vnto the king and ſayd vnto the king: vnderſtand O king, that the law of the Medes and Perſians is, that no decree nor ſtatute which the kyng confirmeth, may be altered.
